text: Guarantees workflows resume exactly where they left off after crashes, network failures, or infrastructure outages
quote: Temporal delivers crash-proof execution by guaranteeing that applications resume exactly where they left off after crashes, network failures, or infrastructure outages

text: Official CLI command to spin up a local dev Temporal server
quote:
brew install temporal
temporal server start-dev

text: Running the dev command starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your machine
quote: This starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your local machine.

text: Web UI lets you view sample workflows executing in real time
quote: Try Temporal Web UI by opening http://localhost:8233 for viewing your sample workflows executing on Temporal.

text: VS Code extension manages Temporal Cloud control plane resources like Namespaces, Users, Service Accounts, and API keys
quote: Use the extension to manage your Temporal Cloud control plane resources, including Namespaces, Users, Service Accounts, API keys, and perform other operational and administrative tasks.

text: Supports self-hosted production deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or manual setup
quote: Deployment: Choose a deployment approach (Docker, Kubernetes, or manual) and set up a production-ready Temporal Service.

text: Namespaces provide isolation and configurable retention settings
quote: Namespaces: Create and manage Namespace isolation, retention, and related configuration.

text: Payload Codecs and Codec Server let you encrypt sensitive workflow data
quote: Data encryption: Use Payload Codecs and Codec Server patterns to protect sensitive Workflow data.

text: Archival moves closed workflow histories and visibility records to blob storage for long-term retention
quote: Archival: Move closed Workflow Histories and Visibility records to blob storage for longer retention.

text: Multi-Cluster Replication replicates workflow state across clusters for failover and disaster recovery
quote: Multi-Cluster Replication: Replicate Workflow state across clusters for failover and disaster recovery.

text: Activities are automatically retried on failure according to configured policy
quote: If an Activity fails, Temporal automatically retries it based on your configuration.

text: Workflows are defined as real code (Workflows-as-Code), not a no-code builder
quote: Temporal isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code.

text: Can execute a single Standalone Activity without a full workflow
quote: But if you just need to execute a single Activity, use a Standalone Activity.

text: Worker Versioning lets you tag workers and roll out versioned deployments so old and new code paths run separately
quote: The Worker Versioning feature allows you to tag your Workers and programmatically roll them out in versioned deployments, so that old Workers can run old code paths and new Workers can run new code paths.

text: Code changes can be applied to new workflow executions while in-progress executions keep running their original version
quote: It applies a code change to new Workflow Executions while avoiding disruptive changes to in-progress Workflow Executions.

text: Schedules let you start workflow executions at specific times, more flexible than cron jobs
quote: A Schedule contains instructions for starting a Workflow Execution at specific times.

text: Schedules support phase offsets so recurring runs fire at specific human-meaningful times
quote: Use a phase offset when you need your recurring Schedule to fire at a specific, human-meaningful time like every 10 days at 5pm UTC on a particular date

text: Integrates with Google ADK for building AI agents
quote: Google ADK integration

text: Integrates with Vercel AI SDK
quote: Vercel AI SDK integration

text: Can orchestrate workflows, AI apps, and agents across any models, tools, and systems
quote: Orchestrate your workflows, AI apps, and agents across any models, tools, systems, and length of time. Reliably complete complex work at any scale with Durable Execution.

text: On-Demand capacity mode auto-scales namespaces starting at 500 actions-per-second based on usage
quote: By default, all Namespaces start with On-Demand mode at 500 APS, scaling automatically based on 7-day usage.

text: SAML SSO is included
quote: SAML SSO included

text: CLI supports listing namespaces and workflows
quote:
temporal operator namespace list
temporal workflow list

text: Offers 24/7 support with a 30 minute P0 response commitment
quote: 24/7, 30 minute P0
